g.title: RoatheRank1Convo1 begins.
g.text: RoatheRank1Convo1 begins.

g.title: j3998890108
g.text: Evaluate expressions on HellStory counter

g.title: j261101170
g.text: I really must commend you on your audacity! Truly, are you certain you are not an Orokin in disguise? Perhaps hiding your cerulean skin to keep from alerting the others?!

g.title: j2344310335
g.text: Boolean RoatheResetEdgeCase is now true.

g.title: j398786529
g.text: The Void-born anomaly. "The Drifter." The Usurper. Finally, we speak at last. Come. The Devil has a proposal to make...

g.title: j3998890108->j398786529
g.text: false

g.title: j3205838016
g.text: Hello, Roathe.

g.title: j4120765719
g.text: What exactly are you accusing me of?

g.title: j1973333308
g.text: I'm sorry?

g.title: j208605035
g.text: Usurper?

g.title: j923736960
g.text: What... kind of deal?

g.title: j719931517
g.text: What kind of proposal could "the Devil of Tau" possibly have for me?

g.title: j3934513589
g.text: Hello, Roathe.

g.title: j1155016608
g.text: Ah, good! You do in fact know my name! I was certain you must have overlooked it somehow, since you were clearly too busy slaughtering me repeatedly!

g.title: j4149812519
g.text: Do you really have nothing more productive to do?! Or is playing round after round of "Pin the Horn on the Yaznak" really the best use of your time?!

g.title: j2823843988
g.text: Boolean RoatheUsurper is now true.

g.title: j1978598127
g.text: Mm, no need for concern... or excitement. Yet. This is merely a business agreement between two individuals who stand to benefit each other greatly.

g.title: j1885948858
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3874470642
g.text: Now. Listen carefully. The two zealots have been so terribly and painstakingly drab in their repeated objurgation of me. I expect you to rise above such remedial behavior.

g.title: j2832182531
g.text: I find it very hard to believe that all this - all this injustice I have suffered at your hands, all this peeling away of my psyche has not been purely out of spite at your behest!

g.title: j2637522294
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j789248820
g.text: I see my reputation precedes me. Good. It will save us some time.

g.title: j541088674
g.text: I don't take orders from you.

g.title: j450840089
g.text: I'll see what I can do.

g.title: j1554939954
g.text: It didn't seem like a priority?

g.title: j2453802371
g.text: I... just I didn't get around to this earlier.

g.title: j899541002
g.text: You don't remember... but we've been through this before.

g.title: j4139600396
g.text: Ah! That is what you are, yes? The Tenno usurped the Origin System from the Orokin. And you, like a little imposter in the nest, have stolen into this world from your own.

g.title: j2152112604
g.text: And there is no need for concern or excitement... yet. This is merely a business agreement between two individuals who stand to benefit each other greatly.

g.title: j4026548805
g.text: Evaluate expressions on HellKeyPlayed counter

g.title: j1544445100
g.text: See that you do.

g.title: j1959542522
g.text: It didn't seem like -

g.title: j112872753
g.text: Oh! I am so very sorry to have inconvenienced you, I did not realize the slots on your dance card were already booked!

g.title: j4048772158
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j4047247544
g.text: And that makes you, on at least two counts, a Usurper by my measure. (And perhaps a third, if we count what the butler has told me of Duviri, but that is a debate for another time.)

g.title: j3036656298
g.text: You have made that repeatedly and brutally clear, thank you.

g.title: j4151776554
g.text: You have made that quite clear.

g.title: j1434605902
g.text: We shall see.

g.title: j4026548805->j1434605902
g.text: false

g.title: j628739751
g.text: Now, the deal is simple, my charmingly lubricous and vaporous new "friend."

g.title: j2059058136
g.text: It didn't seem like a priority?!

g.title: j3693187149
g.text: Really. I am astonished. Your manners are utterly atrocious, Drifter.

g.title: j722170749
g.text: Pardon? And how precisely is it that I have come to forget you rummaging through my mind like the Malium Bowl at a Naberus party!

g.title: j1071362491
g.text: Evaluate expressions on HellKeyPlayed counter

g.title: j3462297797
g.text: Do you normally go mouling about in the memories of others, laying waste to their representations, without taking the opportunity to know them first?!

g.title: j2164462441
g.text: But I suppose there is nothing to be done about it now. You know the truth. I am laid bare to you, in all my abhorrent cowardice.

g.title: j4193578294
g.text: Long story short, there's... the Infestation that seems to extend to the Protoframe serums...

g.title: j2943151773
g.text: Ah. Well. So. I have the ability to loop time.

g.title: j367200717
g.text: Since you have already been bashing about inside my mind like a drunken razaliorn inside of a glassmaker's shop, I require your assistance in attempting to decode what it all means.

g.title: j1654083186
g.text: You and the two zealots have already begun messing about inside my mind like a drunk razaliorn inside of a glassmaker's shop. I require your assistance in helping me decode what it all means.

g.title: j904201011
g.text: When Albrecht drove the syringe into my neck and turned me into this - thing - he did something else, as well. Games between Orokin are one thing. This? This is something else.

g.title: j1071362491->j904201011
g.text: false

g.title: j1192339394
g.text: Your manners are utterly atrocious!

g.title: j3060459772
g.text: I assume you have simply come here now to mock me. I request that you have your fill of it now so that we might move on from it uninterrupted.

g.title: j2804798922
g.text: And I thought that it worked on the Protoframes in 1999 because of the year itself looping, but that's not the case.

g.title: j2302194303
g.text: Not only do I need your assistance in regaining my memories - but to add insult to injury, I seem unable to even find the means to discern their truth on my own!

g.title: j721566316
g.text: He robbed me of much of my memories. I see that little... version of you, running about with all its traumatized Tenno friends. I see what the Lotus is helping it regain.

g.title: j3216264471
g.text: I would rather not have to continually contend with this being underfoot like some diva's ornamentally bred yapping kubrow.

g.title: j3790354511
g.text: I think it's... more to do with the Infestation itself? There's a talking guitar that kind of hinted at some of it. And you traveled here in a Helminth, didn't you?

g.title: j1089778597
g.text: So you're saying you... just need to talk to someone?

g.title: j241721445
g.text: I'm happy to help you if I can, I just don't really know how.

g.title: j2450593060
g.text: So... why don't you go into the dark refractory on your own?

g.title: j1295822232
g.text: The kid isn't an "it."

g.title: j1552731126
g.text: You ran. But a lot of people run. It's about facing what happened.

g.title: j748066435
g.text: I'm not going to mock you. You made the choice to fight another day.

g.title: j3014459645
g.text: You seem alarmingly uncertain about this entire conversation, Drifter. Especially when it comes to the contents of my skull.

g.title: j1327393170
g.text: Oh do not make this sound like I simply need to lay on some reclined sofa and speak through my "feelings."

g.title: j4003769197
g.text: I need someone to operate the machine at my behest, as I am currently incapable of doing so myself.

g.title: j4138408177
g.text: I would do the deed myself, believe me - but I cannot! The blasted protoframe serum Albrecht poisoned me with removed any ability I have of operating the damnable contraption on my own!

g.title: j2342194403
g.text: I assure you, "it" very much is.

g.title: j1840721981
g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j220037017
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j2787933628
g.text: And yes. I did come here via a Helminth. That I engineered and grew myself, thank you. Now. You mean to tell me that you have... erased my memories?! Of what, our conversations together?!

g.title: j1477276666
g.text: I am also in need of someone to help me record my memories and assist me in reconciling them. A temporary assistant of sorts.

g.title: j1752861865
g.text: And in addition, not only do I need your assistance in regaining my memories - but to add insult to injury, I seem unable to even find the means to discern their truth on my own!

g.title: j1680714592
g.text: And I would do the deed myself, believe me - but I cannot! The blasted protoframe serum Albrecht poisoned me with removed any ability I have of operating the damnable contraption on my own!

g.title: j3780424695
g.text: Fantastic. Another buzzing dolefly to dart around my ears and tell me I am in need of self-reflection and reptentance?

g.title: j1124017500
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2875070676
g.text: Because I certainly have perfectly "fond" memories of you rendering me unto mincemeat for your own sanguinary entertainment. How is that meant to make any sense whatsoever?

g.title: j3273596864
g.text: And in return - you will have my solemn pledge that I will sit here... peacefully. I will pose no one any threat, of which I assure you... I am quite capable of being. I will do no harm to the zealots. Or to the butler. Or to Albrecht's Void-corrupted animals.

g.title: j1736345938
g.text: Lucky me.

g.title: j548643132
g.text: Currently, what I am doing seems to be "moldering in a crypt with a pair of gormless zealots and dolling out trinkets to war-traumatized children."

g.title: j1181024595
g.text: I don't know, and I'm not exactly here to continue taking abuse from you, Roathe. I didn't loop everyone just so I could catch flack from you over it.

g.title: j4211392604
g.text: As far as I can guess? Our conversations aren't deep rooted. They're surface memories. What we uncovered in your past were... more part of your core memories, I guess?

g.title: j1245816585
g.text: And more importantly, I will do no harm to Albrecht's twisted family that sits about like so much mutated flora above us - unwitting to our very presence.

g.title: j2189467256
g.text: I plan to go about my business, Drifter, but the fact remains - you know too much about my past and what I've done. And we will have to simply... exist in this state.

g.title: j627658795
g.text: But I suppose that must be what they call it now.

g.title: j185216594
g.text: Yes. I could hazard a guess as to why you have summoned your Void-gifts to wipe our minds of recent events. How perfectly predictable.

g.title: j3310740470
g.text: Fantastic. Utterly marvelous. I am in the hands now of a lunatic who has the ability to wipe my memories clean at a whim! How adorable.

g.title: j490930481
g.text: I thought this was a deal. Now you're threatening me?

g.title: j2306372377
g.text: Roathe? Please stop and listen to me for a second.

g.title: j1426809087
g.text: What do you need me to do?

g.title: j4044212388
g.text: Try not to make this too unduly uncomfortable for me and I will promise that I shall try to do the same in return.

g.title: j3956244044
g.text: Well. If what you say is true - and I suppose this tale is mad enough to be reality - I will attempt not to hold it against you that you know this deep and terrible truth of mine.

g.title: j1718688280
g.text: Were you not paying attention? Really, reading comprehension these days... I was not threatening you, Usurper. Nor was I threatening anyone else.

g.title: j1051471433
g.text: This ought to be grand. Please. Go right ahead; the proverbial theatre is yours.

g.title: j3035375799
g.text: Were you not paying attention? Really, reading comprehension these days... I am attempting to strike a deal with you, Usurper. I have a hard time believing you cannot follow along.

g.title: j2515996925
g.text: No.

g.title: j3664448750
g.text: I think that's fair.

g.title: j2489885509
g.text: Though I would request - if I may - that you would get your fill of whatever mocking you wish to levy in my direction so that we might move on from it uninterrupted.

g.title: j2518589157
g.text: I was merely stating that should we reach a point where I am unable to reach my end goals, I may have no reason to sit quietly any longer.

g.title: j1191959298
g.text: I'm the reason Ballas is dead. Don't make me clear my schedule.

g.title: j2147273050
g.text: If you want my help, this isn't a very good way of getting it.

g.title: j2431737121
g.text: I know you and I don't have much experience with each other - not really. But I'm here to help you.

g.title: j3504410037
g.text: If my proposal does not reach your standards, shall I sweeten it for you?

g.title: j1372488935
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1674042230
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j533389043
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3794748570
g.text: And if you want mine, then I suggest - as I said - we come to an agreement.

g.title: j3373306767
g.text: And? Ah. I see. You are objecting to my "tone" is it? I am so terribly sorry. I did not realize you bristle so easily.

g.title: j3292850606
g.text: It has come to my attention that there are a great many matters around Deimos where my assistance could be considered not only viable, but I dare say, crucial.

g.title: j3501278581
g.text: Ha! I do have to respect your honesty, if nothing else.

g.title: j3158823762
g.text: Wonderful. It is good to know you are at least... agreeable.

g.title: j968884166
g.text: If you could have just heard me laugh! Thank you, Drifter, for very much not being tedious!

g.title: j4148161832
g.text: Including, but not limited to, the reconciliation of one lovelorn butler and said estranged family who lives upstairs.

g.title: j3441318102
g.text: Boolean RoatheKnowsReset is now true.

g.title: j2740354885
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j1058084919
g.text: A family who, as I mentioned, has no idea that we are even down here. And has no knowledge of Albrecht's continued existence amongst the living, am I correct?

g.title: j765641980
g.text: At least this will be interesting.

g.title: j3456191803
g.text: What a delight that was! I think you and I will be friends, indeed. This was quite wonderful.

g.title: j2021818033
g.text: You're offering to help convince Loid to... talk to the Entrati family?

g.title: j22720529
g.text: I can't convince Loid to do anything about it. He claims it'd be too painful for them.

g.title: j3024817668
g.text: They don't know Albrecht Entrati is still alive, no.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j2012370339
g.text: I think, for that, I shall reward you. And make my end of the deal just a little bit sweeter for you. Such audacity is rare.

g.title: j1347778543
g.text: Not for free, my Void-addled Usurper.

g.title: j2226105739
g.text: You cannot. But I promise you... I can.

g.title: j4197397243
g.text: And where you have failed to convince that disconsolate manservant? I promise you... I can.

g.title: j2589118510
g.text: And so we finally come to my proposal: help me sort out the matter of my missing memories, and get to the "bottom" of it all - no pun intended.

g.title: j3796628326
g.text: And I will ensure our heartsick servant walks up those stairs. And, in the meanwhile, I will seat peacefully... and be no danger to anyone. What say you? Do we have a deal?

g.title: j1749515665
g.text: No deal.

g.title: j2144096910
g.text: Deal.

g.title: j2538694841
g.text: As you wish. But fair warning:

g.title: j1482641512
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j401033893
g.text: Boolean RoatheNoDeal is now true.

g.title: j2758828816
g.text: Good! Glad to see you aren't a fool. As they say:

g.title: j2023486135
g.text: Crossing a devil is worse than dealing with one.

g.title: j3520305401
g.text: Boolean RoatheDeal is now true.

g.title: j355014972
g.text: Both you'll come to regret, but only with one do you stand to benefit.
